flashcards.back: A circle split into wedges that show fractions of a whole: in the animation the whole is 12 pupils, with apples 1/2, bananas 1/4 and grapes 1/4.
Points joined by a line to show how a value changes over time: plants sold were Jan 20, Feb 35, Mar 30 and Apr 50.
Bars whose heights show amounts that can be compared: soccer 13 votes, badminton 8 votes and swimming 3 votes.
The numbers along an axis that say what the drawing stands for: graph A runs 0 to 50 while graph B runs 0 to 200.

Steepness is judged by the drawing rather than the axis scale behind it. Slope depends on the axis scale: two graphs can have the same rise but look different. In the animation scene s4 both shops rose by +20, from 20 to 40, even though one line looks steeper.
flashcards.front: A steeper line always means a bigger increase.
In the pie chart of 12 pupils, 6 chose apples, 3 chose bananas and 3 chose grapes. What fraction of the class chose bananas?
Soccer got 13 votes and badminton got 8 votes. How many more votes did soccer get? Show the working.

items.answer: Sales dipped in March; 50 plants were sold in April.
items.prompt: A line graph shows plants sold: Jan 20, Feb 35, Mar 30, Apr 50. In which month did sales dip, and how many plants were sold in April?
